item.title: Cosmic rays from a nearby supernova may help explain Earth-like planets
item.description: How common are Earth-like planets in the universe? When I started working on supernova explosions, I never imagined that my research would eventually lead me to ask a question about the origin of Earth-like planets. Yet that is exactly where it brought me.

item.title: Muddy eruption at Yellowstone's Black Diamond Pool captured on video
item.description: "Kablooey!" That's the word U.S. Geological Survey volcanic experts used to describe a muddy eruption at Black Diamond Pool in Yellowstone National Park on Saturday morning.

item.title: SN 2022ngb is a faint and slow-evolving Type IIb supernova, observations reveal
item.description: An international team of astronomers has conducted optical and near-infrared observations of a supernova designated SN 2022ngb. As a result, it was found that SN 2022ngb is a faint and slow-evolving Type IIb supernova with a low-mass envelope. The new findings were presented Dec. 10 on the arXiv preprint server.

item.title: Life's first molecule: Borate boosts its formation, finds study
item.description: The transition from simple chemistry to the complex biology of molecules that gave rise to life is a puzzle that scientists have been trying to solve for ages.

item.title: Paraplegic engineer becomes the first wheelchair user to blast into space
item.description: A paraplegic engineer from Germany blasted off on a dream-come-true rocket ride with five other passengers Saturday, leaving her wheelchair behind to float in space while beholding Earth from on high.

item.title: Hot, humid weather during pregnancy poses far greater risks to child health than heat alone
item.description: The dangers of heat and humidity are so well known it's become cliché to mention them. But the impacts can extend farther than even scientists and doctors realized.
